def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    vals = {x for row in grid for x in row}
    sep = max(vals, key=lambda v: sum(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid))
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + hr + [h], [-1] + vc + [w]
    result = []
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])]
            counts = {v: cells.count(v) for v in set(cells)}
            rare = [v for v, n in counts.items() if n == 1]
            majority = max(counts, key=counts.get)
            row.append(majority if len(rare) == 1 else 1)
        result.append(row)
    return result
